name: Tenant-isolated Drive files.list read contract
trigger: Create two verified issuer/subject accounts with same-name synthetic files; interleave listing, page-token reuse, expiry, refresh, logout, revoke and missing-scope requests.
observe: each tenant receives only its own file IDs
refresh and revocation affect only the selected tenant
Google API and credential persistence capabilities remain absent
expected: The read-only listFiles contract isolates both datasets and credentials by tenant, rejects cross-tenant context and page tokens, and performs no real Google call or credential persistence.
